lines.en: Max, there is plenty of time before the show, but only a few seats are left in the front rows.
lines.pt: Max, há bastante tempo antes do espetáculo, mas só restam alguns lugares nas primeiras fileiras.

lines.en: A few is enough for us. There are just three of us, and we have a little money saved for tickets.
lines.pt: Alguns bastam para nós. Somos só três, e temos um pouco de dinheiro guardado para os ingressos.

lines.en: True, but I have very little patience for bad seats. Last time I could see little more than the actors’ shoes.
lines.pt: Verdade, mas tenho muito pouca paciência para lugares ruins. Da última vez vi pouco mais que os sapatos dos atores.

lines.en: Few people enjoy sitting behind a pillar. There is plenty of space near the middle, though, if we pay a bit more.
lines.pt: Poucas pessoas gostam de sentar atrás de uma coluna. Mas há bastante espaço no meio, se pagarmos um pouco mais.

lines.en: How much more? I have very little cash with me, and the box office accepts only a few cards.
lines.pt: Quanto mais? Tenho muito pouco dinheiro vivo comigo, e a bilheteria aceita só alguns cartões.

lines.en: Plenty of people pay by card nowadays, but not here. I have a little cash in my jacket.
lines.pt: Muita gente paga com cartão hoje em dia, mas aqui não. Tenho um pouco de dinheiro no casaco.

lines.en: Good. A few friends told me this production has wonderful reviews, and plenty of critics loved the lead actor.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Alguns amigos me disseram que esta produção tem críticas maravilhosas, e muitos críticos adoraram o ator principal.

lines.en: I read that few tickets remain for Saturday, but there are plenty for Sunday. Which day suits you better?
lines.pt: Li que restam poucos ingressos para sábado, mas há bastante para domingo. Qual dia é melhor para você?

lines.en: Saturday. We still have plenty of time to eat first, and a little money left for coffee at the interval.
lines.pt: Sábado. Ainda temos bastante tempo para comer antes, e um pouco de dinheiro para o café no intervalo.

lines.en: Perfect. I slept only a few hours, so I might doze off, but I will try not to snore.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Dormi só algumas horas, então posso cochilar, mas vou tentar não roncar.

lines.en: Few things are worse than a snoring friend in a quiet theatre, so please drink plenty of coffee at the interval.
lines.pt: Poucas coisas são piores que um amigo roncando num teatro silencioso, então beba bastante café no intervalo.

facts.big: quantificadores: plenty of, a few/few, a little/little
facts.label: Plenty of time, a few seats
facts.sub: contável: a few / few · incontável: a little / little · plenty of para os dois

facts.label: a few seats
facts.sub: A few + substantivo contável no plural significa “alguns”: a few seats. Few significa “poucos, quase nenhum”: Few people enjoy sitting behind a pillar.

facts.label: a little money
facts.sub: A little + incontável significa “um pouco”: a little money. Little significa “pouco, quase nada”: I have very little patience. Com little o tom é negativo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.why: Seats are countable: a few seats.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A few means some, enough. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is positive.)
Few means almost none. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is negative.)
We say a little seats. → Falso (Seats are countable: a few seats.)

pages.title: There’s plenty of time, but only a few seats · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm evening in Atlanta. Hal and Max stand outside an old theatre. A long line waits at the box office. Posters of the new play cover the walls. The doors open in an hour. They count their money.

“Max, there is plenty of time before the show, but only a few seats are left in the front rows.” says Hal. “A few is enough for us. There are just three of us, and we have a little money saved for tickets.” says Max. “True, but I have very little patience for bad seats. Last time I could see little more than the actors’ shoes.” says Hal.
